card.name: Linking words before increased-effect terms
card.fires_on: Small linking words such as with, of, to, in, or additional, right before a phrase about higher, additional or increased effects or risks. Seen in drug interaction and warning text.

modes.label: Link before higher rate
modes.description: A preposition after 'associated' or 'results' that leads into a higher rate or increase.
modes.example: higher dosages were associated<< with>> a higher rate of adverse reactions

modes.label: Additional before effects
modes.description: The word 'additional' leading into extra reductions or increases in an effect.
modes.example: should be avoided because<< additional>> reductions in alertness and additional impairment of

modes.label: Of before risk term
modes.description: The word 'of' in a heading about increased risk of a named condition.
modes.example: Amlodipine Increased Risk<< of>> Myopathy and Rhabdomyol

card.writes: It seems to prepare the next word to be about an effect, outcome or risk term rather than a factor.
card.plain: It marks the small word just before the text says an effect or risk will be greater.
